patch.value: GH-1630: bound selective linked-test receipts to the selected collection

GitHub report https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1630 reproduces pm test --run --only-last printing every linked test record despite selecting one command. Keep selection and skipped-count facts while bounding default receipt collections; preserve an explicit route to full linked evidence and avoid redundant successful-selection warning prose. This is a receipt/context-budget enhancement distinct from completed selector execution and ordering work.

Cover only-last and other selectors on a multi-test item through CLI and SDK; preserve complete stored evidence and skipped counts; document the full-evidence restore path and measured receipt-token reduction.
A selected run emits selected evidence and complete selection/count metadata by default; explicit full reads restore the whole collection without weakening immutable run history.
